title: Stonecutter and uncut gems
body:
Similar to ingots needing to be cooled, gems now need to be cut.

Breaking gemstone ore gives you an uncut gem. You cut it by tossing it onto a Stonecutter, which uses sand as fuel. As with ingot cooling, gems are cut the moment they touch the Stonecutter's blade. It's instant.
